display.purpose: Hero metric numbers — revenue, calories, countdown. One per section. Full accent color + glow text-shadow.

headline.purpose: Section titles, major card headers. Scramble-reveals on mount via Anime.js scrambleText.

title.purpose: Tab labels, venture names, agent names.

label.purpose: Timestamps, status badges, metadata. Uppercase for chips.

shadows.name: glow-ai
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on display-scale AI metrics. Also box-shadow on active agent cards via glow-breathe keyframe.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus. Color is the section accent.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: All Anime.js animated entrances. Cards, progress bars, rings, section transitions.

motion.name: spring-count-up
motion.purpose: Anime.js spring easing for count-up numbers. Settles without overshoot.

motion.name: card-stagger
motion.purpose: Anime.js stagger() delay between card entrances.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: All numeric stat values count from 0 to target on mount.

motion.name: progress-bar
motion.purpose: Progress bar width 0 → actual value on mount.

motion.name: ring-draw
motion.purpose: SVG createDrawable stroke animation for agent and topic rings.

motion.name: log-entry
motion.purpose: Activity log entries translate in from bottom.

motion.name: glow-breathe
motion.purpose: CSS @keyframes box-shadow oscillation on agent cards.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar collapses to icon-only below this width.

breakpoints.name: particle-reduce
breakpoints.purpose: Particle count drops from 90 to 50 below this width.

components.css: .ds-agent-card { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.25); border-radius: 12px; border-top: 3px solid #8b5cf6; padding: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; animation: ds-glow-breathe 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-glow-breathe { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(139,92,246,0.3); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(139,92,246,0.6); } } .ds-ring-svg { width: 120px; height: 120px; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-ring-track { fill: none; stroke: rgba(139,92,246,0.2); stroke-width: 8; } .ds-ring-fill { fill: none; stroke: #8b5cf6; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-agent-ring-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-agent-status { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #8b5cf6; } .ds-agent-name { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #f1f5f9; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-agent-purpose { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #94a3b8; margin: 0 0 4px 0; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-agent-venture { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #8b5cf6; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-task-count { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8b5cf6; } .ds-agent-log { background: #0f1117; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; overflow-y: auto; max-height: 160px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-log-entry { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-log-ts { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #475569; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-log-text { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-log-cursor { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #8b5cf6; animation: ds-blink 1s step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a dark, high-information environment for someone who knows exactly what they're doing — and now, it moves. Every screen is a command surface with real-time presence: numbers count up, a particle field drifts behind everything, agent rings pulse when work is in flight. The design earns trust through precision and motion together.

The five section accents (emerald, amber, blue, purple, cyan) are now used at full palette depth. Each accent appears at three intensities: a 0.14 opacity background tint on cards (dim), 0.25 opacity on hover and active states (mid), and solid on key metrics and glowing indicators (full).

Layout is full-bleed. Content fills the viewport after the sidebar. On a wide monitor, sections render two- or three-column layouts instead of a single narrow column.
keyCharacteristics: Five section identities unified by a single dark base, each vivid at three tiers of intensity
Particle field background: drifting neural network, always present, never distracting
Anime.js animation throughout: count-up numbers, scramble reveals, staggered entrances, SVG rings
Agent Tracker as live command center: animated completion rings, scrollable activity logs, task checklists
Full-bleed layout; sections own their grids with no global centering constraint
Flat tonal layering (no shadows), depth through background steps
No gradients on card backgrounds; no gradient text

rules.name: The Full-Palette Rule
rules.body: Each section accent operates at three intensities, not one. A card tinted at 0.14 opacity, a hover state at 0.25, and a glowing metric number at full saturation is the minimum expression for any section.

rules.name: The Five-and-None Rule
rules.body: The five section accents are reserved for their section. Accent colors do not cross section boundaries.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients are forbidden on text, card backgrounds, and section headers. Solid low-opacity tints only on cards.

rules.name: The Weight Gap Rule
rules.body: Display is 700; headline is 600; everything below is 400-500. Each step is felt, not calculated.

rules.name: The Scramble Rule
rules.body: Section titles and agent names scramble-reveal via Anime.js scrambleText on mount. Body copy, labels, and metadata do not scramble.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. The only box-shadows are focus rings on inputs and the glow-breathe on Active agents — status, not depth.

rules.name: The Move-Not-Light Rule
rules.body: Hover feedback is translateY(-2px). The surface moves; it does not illuminate.

rules.name: The No-Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe is prohibited on all surfaces. Active states use background fills, not left borders.

dos: Do use the three-tier accent system on every card: 0.14 tint at rest, 0.25 on hover/active, solid on key metrics.
Do animate every numeric stat on section mount via Anime.js spring count-up.
Do use scrambleText for section headlines and agent names on mount.
Do use createDrawable for all SVG ring animations.
Do use stagger() with 60ms delay between cards for all list and grid entrances.
Do use full-bleed layout within each section. No max-w-5xl or centering wrappers.
Do use rgba(accent, 0.25) full background fills on active sidebar items with the icon in solid accent.
Do apply text-shadow: 0 0 20px <accent> to display-scale metric numbers.
Do apply filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px <accent>) to section header icons.
Do make Active agents visually unmistakable: pulsing ring, blinking cursor, 0.25 card fill.
Do use transform: translateY(-2px) as the universal hover lift.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any surface.
Don't build generic SaaS dashboards with hero-metric templates inside gradient cards.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use gradients on card backgrounds.
Don't use the terminal aesthetic as personality: no green-on-black, no monospace-as-personality.
Don't let section accent colors bleed across sections.
Don't animate CSS layout properties that trigger reflow.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't scramble body copy, labels, or metadata.
Don't constrain the layout with a global max-width.
